flags.rationale: Both test tetanus booster timing, but the clean/minor wound item tests the 10-year threshold while the dirty/major wound item tests the 5-year threshold. These are distinct policy states and retaining both improves discrimination of a commonly confused rule.

The first item covers low anti-HBs after a completed series with HBIG plus revaccination; the second covers documented nonresponse after two complete series with two HBIG doses and no additional vaccine. The management states are clinically distinct.

contentMix.note: This is a controlled source/review-throughput pilot across five prevention/management source packages, not an NEET-PG blueprint sample.
